summary: E2E backend+frontend testing of Merchant & Driver Settings pages (edit -> save -> reload persistence). Backend 15/15 pytest pass. Frontend merchant flow fully passes including misspelling fix, storefront nav, password change (with mismatch/wrong-current toasts). Driver settings has a CRITICAL runtime crash after saving vehicle details when banking_info is null on the driver record.

minor.issue: Requires new_password >= 8 chars, but frontend only enforces >= 6 chars (MerchantSettings.js:87 and DriverSettings.js:93). User can hit backend 400 with a 6-7 char password. Align frontend to 8 chars.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'Cannot read properties of null (reading bank_name)' after clicking Save vehicle details. Cause: PUT /api/drivers/profile returns the full driver doc including banking_info: null (when no banking info has been entered yet). saveVehicle() does setDriver((d) => ({ ...d, ...data.driver })) which overwrites the initialised nested banking_info object ({bank_name:'', ...}) with null. Subsequent render of the Banking section reads driver.banking_info.bank_name and throws. This makes the banking edit form unreachable for any driver who saves vehicle details before banking, and also breaks reload persistence flow once triggered.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: In DriverSettings.js saveVehicle (~line 76), merge with a null-safe banking_info: setDriver((d) => ({ ...d, ...data.driver, banking_info: data.driver?.banking_info || d.banking_info })). Same defensive merge should be applied in the initial load useEffect and after saveBank.

ui_bugs.issue: Password length validation mismatch with backend (frontend allows >=6, backend requires >=8). Users see generic backend error instead of an inline validation message.

integration_issues.flow: Driver Settings — save vehicle then edit banking
integration_issues.issue: React error overlay replaces the whole DriverSettings page after save-vehicle, so banking, account, and password sections become inaccessible without a full page reload.

action_items: FIX (critical): DriverSettings.js saveVehicle spread overwrites banking_info with null → runtime crash. Use null-safe merge (see fix_hint).
Also defensively normalise banking_info in the initial load and after saveBank in DriverSettings.js so d.banking_info is always an object with the 4 string fields.
Align frontend password length validation (6 → 8) with backend in both MerchantSettings.js:87 and DriverSettings.js:93.
critical_code_review_comments: DriverSettings saveVehicle merges backend driver doc without guarding null nested fields — same pattern in MerchantSettings.saveProfile is safer because merchant profile normalisation guarantees an address object, but should still be defended.
Frontend & backend password policy diverge (6 vs 8 chars). Move length constant to shared config or match values.
Both settings pages call GET /auth/me and vendor/driver GETs in Promise.all — good. No auth-loss recovery if token expires mid-session.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend PUT /api/drivers/profile returns the full driver doc post-update. If the driver's stored banking_info is null (or vehicle_info/personal_info is null) and the frontend spreads that into state on top of a UI-initialised {bank_name:'',...} object, it will null-crash the render. Verify the fix by: register+create driver (no banking), promote to driver, open /driver/settings, edit vehicle fields, click Save vehicle details, then confirm Banking card is still rendered and editable. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_settings_e2e_iter39.py can be re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_settings_e2e_iter39.py -v
rca of the issue: Root cause: DriverSettings.js line ~76 `setDriver((d) => ({ ...d, ...data.driver }))`. Because the driver was created without banking_info, MongoDB stores `banking_info: null` (Pydantic Driver model default). The PUT response echoes that field. The spread copies `banking_info: null` over the UI-side normalised object, so the very next render of the Banking JSX at line 180 dereferences `driver.banking_info.bank_name` on null and throws. Reproduction: 1) create driver without banking, 2) open /driver/settings, 3) edit any vehicle field, 4) click 'Save vehicle details' — the entire page is replaced by React's error overlay. Mitigation: null-safe merge of nested fields in saveVehicle and always normalise data.driver.banking_info to an object shape before merging into state.
